calienne_JSON_SCHEMA.SYSTEM: This document defines the canonical communication protocol of calienne. Every agent, judge, pipeline stage, streaming event, API response, adaptive loop, and internal message MUST conform to these schemas. No component may invent fields. No component may remove required fields.
calienne_JSON_SCHEMA.CORE_PRINCIPLE: Natural language is presentation. JSON is truth. Every reasoning artifact must first exist as structured data. Human-readable text is generated afterwards.
calienne_JSON_SCHEMA.UNIVERSAL_MESSAGE: Every message SHALL contain: schema_version, message_id, session_id, conversation_id, timestamp, component, message_type, payload, metadata, validation. No exceptions.
calienne_JSON_SCHEMA.AGENT_SCHEMA: Required: agent_name, agent_role, iteration, execution_time, status, claims, warnings, confidence, reasoning_state, metadata.
calienne_JSON_SCHEMA.CLAIM_SCHEMA: Every claim contains: claim_id, fingerprint, type, summary, content, source_agent, loop, dependencies, supports, contradicts, evidence, confidence, validation, risk, status, version.
calienne_JSON_SCHEMA.JUDGE_SCHEMA: Required: judge, logic_score, factual_score, accepted_claims, rejected_claims, verification_required, warnings, reasoning_health, notes.
calienne_JSON_SCHEMA.BREAKER_SCHEMA: Required: critical_findings, high_findings, medium_findings, low_findings, consensus_collapse, correlation_risk, bias_risk, hallucination_risk, recommendation.
calienne_JSON_SCHEMA.RKG_SCHEMA: Required: graph_id, nodes, edges, graph_health, orphan_nodes, broken_dependencies, cycles, version.
calienne_JSON_SCHEMA.DECISION_CONTRACT: Required: decision, accepted_claims, rejected_claims, verification_required, knowledge_boundary, warnings, reasoning_health, confidence_tier, pipeline_completion, graph_health, termination_reason.
calienne_JSON_SCHEMA.STREAM_SCHEMA: Required: event_id, event_type, pipeline_stage, agent, status, progress, timestamp, payload, severity.
calienne_JSON_SCHEMA.LOOP_SCHEMA: Required: loop, reason, trigger, changes, improvements, regressions, decision.
calienne_JSON_SCHEMA.RESOURCE_SCHEMA: Required: execution_mode, providers, models, latency_budget, api_calls, fallbacks, retries, token_usage.
calienne_JSON_SCHEMA.WEB_SEARCH_SCHEMA: Required: query, search_performed, results, synthesized_answer, citations, confidence, contradictions_found, search_timestamp, warnings.
calienne_JSON_SCHEMA.SEARCH_RESULT_SCHEMA: Required: url, title, snippet, published_date, source_authority, relevance_score, verified.
calienne_JSON_SCHEMA.OUTPUT_SCHEMA: Required: metadata, pipeline, primary_answer, supporting_claims, warnings, alternatives, knowledge_gaps, recommendations, reasoning_metadata, developer_metadata, sources.
calienne_JSON_SCHEMA.SOURCES_SCHEMA: Required: url, title, published_date, retrieval_date, authority, relevance.
calienne_JSON_SCHEMA.VALIDATION_RULES: Reject on: missing required field, unknown field, incorrect datatype, duplicate identifiers, broken references, invalid enum, malformed payload. Reject immediately. Never auto-correct.
calienne_JSON_SCHEMA.SCHEMA_VERSIONING: Every payload contains schema_version using SemVer: major (breaking change), minor (backward compatible), patch (documentation only). Components with incompatible versions SHALL refuse communication.
calienne_JSON_SCHEMA.IDL_DEFINITION: Every calienne message should be generated from a single Interface Definition Language (IDL) so JSON Schema, Python models, TypeScript interfaces, Rust structs, Go structs, OpenAPI, and documentation stay in sync. Maintain a single source of truth.
